title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – 2027 pricing: proposal for review by your pricing committee
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer. We value our long partnership and want a stable 2027 supply.

Your scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 shows 273 ppm, above the 250 ppm in your standard terms.
The same scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 records on-time delivery of only 90.4 %.
Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records an 11.9 % volume increase, which secures 6110 pieces per year over a 12-month contract.

The attached packages offer longer payment terms in exchange for a lower price. Your requested change exceeds 2 %, so we would ask your pricing committee to review them. Is there a cheaper variant of this motor that would meet our specification?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – 2027 pricing: proposal for review by your pricing committee
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your forecast securing 6110 pieces per year and have factored this volume increase into our pricing. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our technical and quality departments will respond to your inquiry regarding alternative variants and the scorecard data separately.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.

Logistics: As part of our standard procedures, please be advised that our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
